rice.name: Rice (Paddy)
rice.soil_type: Clayey loam, Alluvial soil with good water retention
rice.tips: Requires abundant standing water during vegetative stage. Transplant 21-25 day old seedlings.

maize.name: Maize (Corn)
maize.soil_type: Deep well-drained loamy to sandy loam
maize.tips: Avoid waterlogging as roots are sensitive to stagnant water. Ensure good nitrogen application.

chickpea.name: Chickpea (Gram / Chana)
chickpea.soil_type: Well-drained sandy loam to clay loam
chickpea.tips: Requires cool and dry weather. Fixes atmospheric nitrogen, improving soil fertility.

kidneybeans.name: Kidney Beans (Rajma)
kidneybeans.season: Rabi in plains / Kharif in hills
kidneybeans.tips: Requires mild temperatures. Incompatible with heavy water-retentive clay.

pigeonpeas.name: Pigeon Peas (Arhar / Red Gram)
pigeonpeas.soil_type: Deep loam to clay loam, tolerant to medium soils
pigeonpeas.tips: Deep taproot system helps survive low rainfall. Good intercrop with sorghum or maize.

mothbeans.name: Moth Beans (Matki)
mothbeans.tips: Highly suited for arid and semi-arid regions with scanty rainfall.

mungbean.name: Mung Bean (Green Gram / Moong)
mungbean.soil_type: Fertile sandy loam to alluvial loam
mungbean.tips: Short duration crop (60-70 days). Excellent green manure crop.

blackgram.name: Black Gram (Urad)
blackgram.tips: Thrives in warm, humid weather. Enriching for soil nitrogen.

lentil.name: Lentil (Masoor)
lentil.tips: Can tolerate mild frost during early growth. Needs well-drained soil.

pomegranate.name: Pomegranate (Anaar)
pomegranate.soil_type: Well-drained light loamy to sandy soil
pomegranate.tips: Requires hot and dry climate during fruit ripening to develop high sugars.

banana.name: Banana
banana.soil_type: Rich, deep alluvial or volcanic clay loam
banana.tips: Heavy feeder of potassium. Needs protection from strong winds.

mango.name: Mango (Aam)
mango.season: Flowering in winter, harvest in summer
mango.soil_type: Deep well-drained alluvial or lateritic loam
mango.tips: Rainfall or high humidity during flowering can cause anthracnose and poor fruit set.

grapes.name: Grapes (Angoor)
grapes.soil_type: Sandy loam, alluvial, well-drained gravelly soil
grapes.tips: Dry sunny weather is critical during flowering and ripening.

watermelon.name: Watermelon (Tarbooz)
watermelon.tips: Requires prolonged warm sunshine. Reduce watering near harvest to increase sugar.

muskmelon.name: Muskmelon (Kharbooja)
muskmelon.soil_type: Well-drained sandy loam, rich in organic matter
muskmelon.tips: Requires hot dry climate at maturity for sweet aroma and sugar content.

apple.name: Apple (Seb)
apple.season: Perennial (Bloom in spring, harvest July - Oct)
apple.soil_type: Deep well-drained loamy soil with organic humus
apple.tips: Requires winter chilling hours (below 7°C) to break bud dormancy. Best in hill tracts.

orange.name: Orange (Santra / Citrus)
orange.soil_type: Light well-drained loams, slightly acidic to neutral
orange.tips: Sensitive to waterlogging and soil salinity. High potassium boosts rind quality.

papaya.name: Papaya (Papita)
papaya.soil_type: Rich, deep sandy loam, alluvial soil
papaya.tips: Ensure excellent drainage as collar rot occurs rapidly in stagnated water.

coconut.name: Coconut (Nariyal)
coconut.soil_type: Coastal sand, alluvial, red sandy loam
coconut.tips: Thrives in humid tropical coastal belts with constant warm temperatures.

cotton.name: Cotton (Kapas)
cotton.tips: Requires 200 frost-free days and warm sunshine during boll opening.

jute.name: Jute (Golden Fiber)
jute.tips: Requires abundant rainfall and hot humid climate. Retting requires clean water.

coffee.name: Coffee
coffee.season: Perennial (Bloom with blossom showers in March)
coffee.soil_type: Deep, fertile, volcanic or forest laterite loam
coffee.tips: Grown under two tiers of shade trees on hill slopes (700m - 1500m elevation).
